## Rule

Mirror the color-2 mask across the center of the 2x2 color-3 marker. The live graph fills the three reflected quadrants around the marker while preserving padding as all-zero outside the true grid.

## Algorithm sketch

Use a shifted color index (`padding=0`, colors `0..9 -> 1..10`) so padding remains distinct from background. Detect marker rows/cols from 30-element row/column maxima equal to shifted color 3 (`4`), sum their row/col coordinates, reflect source indices as `center_sum - coord`, clamp for Gather, mask out-of-bounds reflections, then paint reflected color-2 cells into a UINT8 shifted-color canvas and finish with `Equal(canvas, [1..10]) -> output`.

## Cost analysis

### v2 floor decomposition (2026-06-01, cost 11,071 = mem 10,984 + par 87)

Verified per-tensor (static == ORT-observed; no profiler inflation):
- `color_p1` **F32 [1,1,30,30] = 3,600** — the Conv color-index plane. **Structural floor / irreducible.** Conv must emit float; this single plane serves BOTH `c2` (`Equal(·,3)`) and the marker detection (`ReduceMax`). Any single-channel extraction from the F32 one-hot input costs ≥3,600 once (Slice/Gather preserve F32; a full `Cast(input,BOOL)` is 9,000). Two separate channel slices (c2 + c3) would cost 7,200 > 3,600.
- **7 × [1,1,30,30] BOOL @ 900 = 6,300**: `c2`, `hr_raw`, `hr`, `A`, `vA_raw`, `vA`, `M`. This is the **minimum plane count for a 4-fold Klein orbit via 2-stage accumulate** (2 Gathers). The two `_raw` planes are the pre-validity gathers; folding validity into the index needs a zero-extended source (`Concat` → [1,1,31,30]≈930), which costs ≈ the `And` it removes (net +30/+60). BOOL is already 1 B/elem (the spatial floor).
- small tensors ≈ 1,084 (marker detect 424 + index math 660) — already 1-op-minimal.

**Practical floor ≈ 10,900; v2 at 11,071 is ~1.02× of it.** Per the prompt's stop-at-1.1× rule, **do not chase sub-11k** — the only big item left is `color_p1` (3,600), proven irreducible above, and the remaining ~500 B would be <+0.05 LB at real risk of breaking byte-equality.

### (historical, pre-v1) Cost 82,314 (memory=82,208, params=106). Memory dominated by: slc_61[1,7,30,30]=25200B (7 input channels), 13× [1,1,30,30] spatial intermediates (mH_43,mV_44,mHV_45,mul_46-49,max_50,sub_51,slc_52,slc_55,add_59,sub_60)=46800B, slc_1+slc_5=7200B. Total large: 79200B. The algorithm computes centroid-based spatial shifts using Gather (row/col shifts + diagonal) with boolean masks — all 30×30 intermediates are algorithmically required.

Two Where(le_23, sub_26, 0)→mul_27 and Where(le_29, sub_32, 0)→mul_33 nodes are provably redundant (le_23=Less(sub_16,30) and le_29=Less(sub_17,30) are always True since sub ranges [-29,29]). Folding saves 60B memory + 2 params (f32_19 and _boolmask_where_zero unused) = 62B total. Too small to build (~+0.00075 pts).

## Don't-do log

- **(v2-era, 2026-06-01) Do NOT chase sub-11k.** v2 (11,071) is ~1.02× the structural floor (≈10,900). The floor is `color_p1` F32 plane (3,600, irreducible — Conv emits float; serves c2+marker) + 7 BOOL spatial planes (6,300, minimum for the 2-stage Klein orbit) + ~1,100 small. See Cost analysis §v2.
- **(v2-era) Zero-extend to drop the `_raw` gather planes**: appending a zero row/col (`Concat`→[1,1,31,30]≈930) to make gathers "born-valid" costs ≈ the `And` validity it removes (net +30/+60). Not worth it — keep `And(gather, valid)`.
- **(v2-era) Drop validity entirely**: would diverge from LIVE on marker-near-edge + color-2-at-edge inputs (clamped Gather reads the wrong row) → breaks byte-equality. The `ab` gate catches it. Validity (`Equal(Clip(src),src)`) is mandatory.
- **(v2-era) QLinearConv/U8 color index** to shrink `color_p1` 3,600→900: needs a U8-quantized input (`QuantizeLinear(input)` = 9,000 B) — net far worse. Conv-F32 single plane is optimal.
- **Equal-fold (Sub→Mul→Less pattern)**: no such chains in this graph; the Less nodes compare directly without squaring.
- **crop-to-active-grid**: spread scan says max active grid IS 30×30 (no crop opportunity).
- **castdtype int64→int8** for ri_38/ci_39: Gather does NOT accept int8 indices (Tind supports only int32 and int64 in opset 11). Use int32 instead.
- **fp16_selective**: fails verify per spread scan.
- **Where-redundancy fold** (2026-05-19): le_23=Always True and le_29=Always True. Folding saves only 62B — not worth building.
